description: This file defines the class `S3EncryptionClientV2` within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically providing a wrapper for S3Client that adds encryption and decryption capabilities for objects stored on S3. The class includes methods for asynchronously and synchronously putting and getting encrypted objects, handling metadata strategies, and managing encryption materials. It utilizes traits for cryptographic functionality and interacts with AWS services and Guzzle promises.

classes.name: S3EncryptionClientV2
classes.description: A wrapper class for AWS S3Client that adds client-side encryption and decryption capabilities for objects stored on Amazon S3. It supports asynchronous and synchronous operations for encrypting data before upload and decrypting data after download, along with management of encryption metadata strategies.

methods.name: putObjectAsync
methods.description: Encrypts the 'Body' content of the provided arguments and asynchronously uploads the encrypted data to S3, returning a promise.

methods.name: putObject
methods.description: Encrypts and uploads an object to S3 synchronously by invoking `putObjectAsync()` and waiting for the promise resolution.

methods.name: getObjectAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an object from S3 and decrypts the data asynchronously, returning a promise.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Synchronously retrieves and decrypts an object from S3 by invoking `getObjectAsync()` and waiting for the promise.
